summary: Implemented and verified phases 4-5 of the 13-phase input-scoped gate invalidation plan (phases 1-3 landed in a prior dispatch). Phase 4 root-caused gate 8's 457s-vs-103s discrepancy: a host-load-independent synthetic sleep probe refuted the scheduler-concurrency candidate outright (it delivers exactly the requested concurrency at every --jobs level), confirmed JOBS_CAP=4 genuinely binds, and identified a structural fourth cause (not originally named) as primary -- one suite's one nested full-battery verify-deploy.sh call, inside gate 8, inside verify-deploy.sh, accounts for roughly a fifth of the entire 151-suite serial-cost sum by itself. Phase 5 landed the --skip-unchanged cache store and opt-in skip decision end-to-end: a per-gate content-addressed cache at specs/.gate-cache/ (gitignored, surviving deploy-headless.sh), a pre-dispatch consult loop that removes a cache-hit gate from dispatch entirely (not merely silencing its output), per-gate write/invalidate bookkeeping via two new reconciled arrays, and a byte-identical default path. Phase 5 also absorbed a significant unplanned performance fix: Phase 3's digest library hashed a gate's resolved corpus via one subprocess per file, never exercised at real scale until this dispatch -- measured at up to 75.6s for the full 23-gate consult loop (and 18-51s for a single gate under contention), which would have defeated the whole feature. Fixed via batched git hash-object calls, vectorized array/paste joins, and per-process memoization; re-measured at 4.4s. All 5 phases committed separately and verified; 28/28 test-gate-cache-lib.sh cases pass (up from 16), 0 shellcheck findings across every touched file. 8 phases remain (6-13), all gate-set efficiency work on individual gates now that invalidation itself is landed and cheap -- the plan's own text invites re-assessing their individual urgency against this post-invalidation state rather than grinding through them unconditionally.

artifacts.summary: Phases 1-5 of 13: measurement-harness hardening, per-gate input_corpus declaration, the content-addressed digest library, the gate-8 root-cause verdict, and the --skip-unchanged cache store and skip decision, including the unplanned performance fix.

Concrete resume point for Phase 6, plus the key decisions, deviations, and what-not-to-try guidance from phases 4-5 (notably: never per-file-subprocess or per-element-string-concat for any corpus-scale operation in gate-cache-lib.sh).
